ImageDescription.value: Extreme macro close-up of the rare fungus Hydnellum peckii. On the snow-white, velvety surface of the mycelium, a large, perfectly shaped scarlet-red guttation droplet with a light reflection is visible, along with small amber-coloured droplets at the edges. The image clearly demonstrates the high surface tension of the syrupy exudate secreted by the fungus.
